newsReports.title: Kwara Command Climbs +2.9 to 6.9 SPS as High-Watch Threat Baselines Hold Steady

featured_image.alt: Kwara State Police Command Security Performance Score Telemetry

newsReports.lead_narrative: Kwara State Police Command led national daily enforcement performance across 37 jurisdictions on 2026-11-20 at 6.9 SPS (+2.9), driven by coordinated operational output. Meanwhile, Borno (5.5 JTI), Zamfara (5.1 JTI), Yobe (4.8 JTI) remained the highest-watch threat jurisdictions with zero net daily movement (+0.0).
newsReports.editorial_notice: This Scored Intelligence Brief translates Security Performance Score (SPS) and Jurisdiction Threat Index (JTI) command telemetry across 37 Nigerian jurisdictions into verified news coverage for Diploman Times.
story_body: Structured under Angle 01 (baseline_deviations), daily command telemetry places Kwara (6.9 SPS, +2.9), Osun (6.6 SPS, +2.6), Nasarawa (6.4 SPS, +2.4) at the top of the Security Performance Score rankings.
Each command's SPS composite weighs Patrol & Response Index (PRI, 35%), Crime Deterrence Index (CDI, 40%), and Rapid Policing Index (RPI, 25%) against calibrated 5.5–7.5 baseline bands.

On the Jurisdiction Threat Index (JTI, 2.5–4.5 baseline band), persistent readings in Borno (5.5 JTI), Zamfara (5.1 JTI), Yobe (4.8 JTI) underscore ongoing containment priorities across the federation.
